curriculum: The cohort-specific 2026–27 regulations and student curriculum establish a 180 EC full-time degree taught in Dutch with some English. Standard totals: 60 EC of first-year courses, 30 EC of advanced specialisation, 15 EC of disciplinary breadth, 7.5 EC preparation and 7.5 EC thesis, 30 EC coherent elective package and 30 EC open elective space. No extra bridging package is required by the cohort regulations. The standard thesis is distinct from the 15 EC research project that uses an extra 7.5 EC of open elective space by agreement.
progression: The first year places pairs in each of four blocks. History of Philosophy II belongs in block 2 and Political and Social Philosophy in block 3. In the second year the four advanced courses run one per block, with Modern Philosophers on Art in block 2 and Continental Philosophy in block 3. Choose the first official package, Ethics and Politics, before judging UCR fit. The published even/odd alternation implies History of Political Philosophy in 2027–28, not both historical courses. The example allows profiling in year 2 blocks 1 and 4 and the remaining 45 EC in year 3. The 30 EC advanced package is all level 3 and meets the 22.5 EC graduation-sequence entry threshold. The preparation seminar in block 1 or 3 feeds the 7.5 EC thesis in the next block. The 30 EC advanced package plus graduation sequence meets the 45 EC level-3 major requirement. At least 15 EC within the 60 EC profiling space must be at level 2 or 3. External minors and study abroad require prior approval; an internship is optional and capped at 15 EC.
components: This course alternates with History of Ethics. Utrecht lists History of Political Philosophy for academic years starting in an odd calendar year, which includes 2027–28.
Students complete at least 22.5 EC at level 3 before beginning the graduation sequence. The seminar prepares the thesis in the following block.
This example uses the 7.5 EC thesis. The 15 EC research project requires agreement with the programme coordinator and uses 7.5 EC of open elective space.
Choose a minor, a second Philosophy specialisation or approved study abroad. Across all 60 EC of elective space, at least 15 EC must be at level 2 or 3.
Choose electives, a second minor or an internship of up to 15 EC.
